sample.title: same call text at four positions (A, C run at load; B, D do not), real Chrome 155 + real extension, capture threshold high (default)

reference.method: author-annotated truth cross-checked by window.__l3Truth() evaluated in Chrome after capture stopped and by an independent node:vm evaluation (test/real-site-l3-browser.test.ts)

observed.method: real Chrome 155 headless=new + real DevTools frontend + real panel + real service worker + real chrome.debugger; programmatic operation (element.click, Runtime.evaluate), NOT manual mouse; applied replacements parsed from the panel own apply report
observed.note: raw evidence collected by scripts/p47-l3-browser-replay.ts and judged offline

identity.basis: reference = sha256 of the page script on disk read by this test; observed = source OB-Recover read from Chrome through its own debugger-get-source (CDP) before apply; afterApply = the same read after both apply clicks. activeScript.source of the panel is module private and cannot be read from outside: that it was not mutated is evidenced indirectly by the second apply passing the URL + source equality gate
